metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear enemy was checking Twitter LOL Valorant logic is wild
metadata.description:
Wait, did I actually land that? Enemy probably AFK texting.
When your aim’s on vacation but kills still happen.
Click if you’ve ever won fights you didn’t train for.

Tap if your kills are accidents but you own them anyway!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckshot #gamingfails #shorts
